answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
